The `pytesseract` library provides a Python interface to Tesseract.\n\n## Installation\n\n```bash\n# Install Tesseract OCR engine (Ubuntu/Debian)\nsudo apt-get install tesseract-ocr\n\n# Install Python wrapper\npip install pytesseract pillow\n```\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n### Simple Text Extraction\n\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image\nimport pytesseract\n\n# Extract text from an image file\nimage = Image.open('receipt.jpg')\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image)\nprint(text)\n```\n\n### Configuration Options\n\n```python\n# Custom configuration for better OCR accuracy\ncustom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, config=custom_config)\n```\n\n#### Page Segmentation Modes (PSM)\n- `0` - Orientation and script detection (OSD) only\n- `1` - Automatic page segmentation with OSD\n- `3` - Fully automatic page segmentation, but no OSD (default)\n- `4` - Assume a single column of text of variable sizes\n- `6` - Assume a single uniform block of text (good for receipts)\n- `7` - Treat the image as a single text line\n- `11` - Sparse text, find as much text as possible in no particular order\n\n#### OCR Engine Modes (OEM)\n- `0` - Legacy engine only\n- `1` - Neural nets LSTM engine only\n- `2` - Legacy + LSTM engines\n- `3` - Default, based on what is available\n\n### Specifying Language\n\n```python\n# Use English language\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, lang='eng')\n\n# Multiple languages\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, lang='eng+chi_sim')\n```\n\n### Whitelist Characters\n\n```python\n# Only recognize digits and certain characters\nconfig = r'--oem 3 --psm 6 -c tessedit_char_whitelist=0123456789.,$'\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, config=config)\n```\n\n## Image Preprocessing for Better OCR\n\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageEnhance\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Increase contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    # Binarization (threshold)\n    threshold = 128\n    img = img.point(lambda x: 255 if x > threshold else 0, '1')\n\n    return img\n```\n\n## Getting Detailed Output\n\n```python\n# Get bounding boxes for characters\nboxes = pytesseract.image_to_boxes(image)\n\n# Get data with confidence scores\ndata = pytesseract.image_to_data(image, output_type=pytesseract.Output.DICT)\n\n# Get structured data\nosd = pytesseract.image_to_osd(image)  # Orientation and script detection\n```\n\n## Best Practices for Receipt OCR\n\n1. **Image Quality**: Ensure good lighting and clear text\n2. **Preprocessing**: Convert to grayscale, increase contrast, apply threshold\n3. **PSM Selection**: Use PSM 4 or 6 for receipt-like documents\n4. **Handle Rotation**: Use OSD to detect and correct rotation\n5. **Post-processing**: Clean up OCR output with regex patterns\n\n## Example: Receipt Text Extraction\n\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance\nimport pytesseract\n\ndef extract_receipt_text(image_path):\n    # Patterns\n\nReceipts use various date formats:\n- `DD/MM/YYYY` - 29/12/2017\n- `DD-MM-YYYY` - 29-12-2017\n- `YYYY-MM-DD` - 2017-12-29\n- `MM/DD/YYYY` - 12/29/2017\n- `DD.MM.YYYY` - 29.12.2017\n-  # Common date patterns\n    patterns = [\n        # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        (r'(\\d{1,2})[/-](\\d{1,2})[/-](\\d{4})', 'DMY'),\n        # YYYY/MM/DD or YYYY-MM-DD\n ]\n\n    # Money pattern: handles RM, $, and comma separators\n    money_pattern = r'(?:RM|rm|\\$)?\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.?\\d{0,2}|\\d+\\.?\\d{0,2})'\n\n    for keyword in priority_keywords:\n Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Auto-contrast to normalize lighting\n    img = ImageOps.autocontrast(img, cutoff=1)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(1.5)\n\n    # Enhance sharpness\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Sharpness(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(1.5)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text(image_path):\n    \"\"\"Extract text from image using Tesseract OCR.\"\"\"\n    img = preprocess_image(image_path)\n\n    # Use PSM 6 for uniform block of text (good for receipts)\n    config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img, config=config, lang='eng')\n\n    return text\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract date from receipt text and return in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).\"\"\"\n\n    # Common date patterns - order matters\n    patterns = [\n        # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY (most common in Malaysian receipts)\n        (r'(\\d{1,2})[/\\-](\\d{1,2})[/\\-](\\d{4})', 'DMY'),\n        # YYYY/MM/DD or YYYY-MM-DD\n        (r'(\\d{4})[/\\-](\\d{1,2})[/\\-](\\d{1,2})', 'YMD'),\n        # DD.MM.YYYY\n        (r'(\\d{1,2})\\.(\\d{1,2})\\.(\\d{4})', 'DMY'),\n    ]\n\n    for pattern, fmt in patterns:\n        matches = re.findall(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            try:\n                if fmt == 'DMY':\n                    day, month, year = int(match[0]), int(match[1]), int(match[2])\n                elif fmt == 'YMD':\n                    year, month, day = int(match[0]), int(match[1]), int(match[2])\n\n                # Validate the date\n                if 1 <= day <= 31 and 1 <= month <= 12 and 1900 <= year <= 2100:\n                    date_obj = datetime(year, month, day)\n                    return date_obj.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')\n            except ValueError:\n                continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract total amount from receipt text.\"\"\"\n\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n    lines_upper = [line.upper() for line in lines]\n\n    # Keywords to look for (priority order from most to least specific)\n    priority_keywords = [\n        ['GRAND TOTAL'],\n        ['TOTAL RM', 'TOTAL: RM', 'TOTAL:RM'],\n        ['TOTAL AMOUNT'],\n        ['TOTAL', 'AMOUNT', 'TOTAL DUE', 'AMOUNT DUE', 'BALANCE DUE', 'NETT TOTAL', 'NET TOTAL'],\n    ]\n\n    # Keywords to skip\n    exclude_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'ROUNDING',\n        'TOTAL INCLUDES', 'TOTAL GST', 'TOTAL QTY'\n    ]\n\n    # Money pattern: handles RM, $, and comma separators\n    # Matches amounts like: 14.10, RM 14.10, RM14.10, 1,234.56\n    money_pattern = r'(?:RM|rm|\\$)?\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}|\\d+\\.\\d{2})'\n\n    for keyword_group in priority_keywords:\n        for keyword in keyword_group:\n            for i, line_upper in enumerate(lines_upper):\n                if keyword in line_upper:\n                    # Skip if exclusion keyword present\n                    if any(excl in line_upper for excl in exclude_keywords):\n                        continue\n\n                    # Use original line for amount extraction (preserves case)\n                    line = lines[i]\n\n                    # Try to find amount in the same line\n                    amounts = re.findall(money_pattern, line, re.IGNORECASE)\n                    if amounts:\n                        # Take the last amount on the line\n                        amount = amounts[-1].replace(',', '')\n                        return format_amount(amount)\n\n                    # Fallback: check next line for split keyword/amount\n                    if i + 1 < len(lines):\n                        next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                        amounts = re.findall(money_pattern, next_line, re.IGNORECASE)\n                        if amounts:\n                            amount = amounts[-1].replace(',', '')\n                            return format_amount(amount)\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef format_amount(amount_str):\n    \"\"\"Format amount to exactly 2 decimal places.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        value = float(amount_str)\n        return f\"{value:.2f}\"\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef process_receipts(image_dir, output_path):\n    \"\"\"Process all receipt images and save results to Excel.\"\"\"\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(image_dir)\n                          if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.bmp', '.tiff'))])\n\n    results = []\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(image_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing: {filename}\")\n\n        try:\n            #
